// path: The centralized tests tree only; jscpd.json owns package and tooling implementation. This is the tests-only ratchet Spine-Testing section 10 names: repeated setup moves to a builder, so the duplicated share may only fall.
// formats: `tsx` is required to see CT files and stories; jscpd's `typescript` format does not tokenize .tsx.
// minTokens: The source settings from jscpd.json, so the two ratios are comparable.
// maxLines: A whole-file skip threshold, not a block cap. Raised above the largest test file so no test is invisible to the ratchet.
// maxSize: Above the largest authored test file, for the same reason.
// threshold: The ratchet: the duplicated-lines percentage measured over tests/ when this config landed. Lower it when the measured share falls; never raise it to admit a copy.
// ignorePattern: Ignore import blocks that are naturally identical across files.
// ignoreCase: Ignore case of symbols to catch stylistic renames.
// noTips: Suppress sponsor and AI tips in CI output.
